services.desc: We believe you deserve not only the finest wines but also the highest level of service. Time and again, our customers have come back to say that they were fully satisfied by their experience at Angelita Vineyard & Winery. Come on out and visit the tasting room where you can choose from several wine flights. Our most popular wine tasting is the Premium Tasting for $15 where you can try 5 wines of your choice. Stop by today enjoy a wine tasting, wine flight, wine by the glass or a bottle of your favorite Angelita Vineyard wine. blurb: Angelita Vineyard & Winery is a small boutique winery located in Angus, Texas, offering a variety of red, white, blush, and sparkling wines made on-site from estate vineyards. Guests can enjoy wine tastings, wine flights, wine by the glass or bottle, and appetizers including cheese plates. The winery hosts holiday specials, harvest parties, and live music events, with indoor and outdoor seating overlooking the vineyard.
